programs.title: Shaidai
programs.desc:
Shaidai is a celebration of love, a story that dares to ask what happens when the most beautiful feeling in the world turns into its greatest test.
Ali Khan stands at the peak of the world others only dream of. Driven, relentless, and accustomed to getting what he wants, yet beneath that iron exterior lives a quietly devoted grandson.
Miral is a self made girl who wants to do everything on her own. Vivid, sharp tongued, and fiercely certain of her own path, she moves through life with a conviction that refuses to be dimmed.
Fate, indifferent to logic and timing, brings their names together. But love, it seems, has made enemies before they even knew it existed. From the shadows, forces driven by old grievances and hidden motives begin to close in, testing not just their bond but everything they believe in.
What storms lie ahead in Ali and Miral’s love? Can two people who found each other against all odds hold on when the odds turn against them? And when love is pushed to its breaking point, who will be left standing?
7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programs.title: Milkiyat
programs.desc:
Soha, a young woman raised by her grandfather after losing her parents, lives a simple yet strong life. She is happily married to Rafay, a loving and caring husband. However, her world falls apart when Rafay dies in a tragic accident.
Zaviyar is a wealthy and arrogant man who has everything in life except true love. He was once deeply in love but after being betrayed, he no longer believes in relationships and keeps his distance from emotions.
Fate brings Soha and Zaviyar together, but they are unaware of their true connection at first. Zaviyar is burdened by guilt from a mistake in his past, and in an attempt to ease it, he begins helping Soha and her family. Over time, this brings him closer to her, and he gradually falls in love.
Will Zaviyar get his love? Why is Soha not convinced by Zaviyar’s love? Can Zaviyar escape the guilt that follows him every step?
7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programs.title: Khush Naseebi
programs.desc:
Khush Naseebi is a heartfelt story of Siraj Qasmi and his three daughters, Narmeen, Maheen, and Emaan.
Siraj Qasmi is a widower who loves his daughters deeply. Narmeen and Maheen are the light of his life, but his heart remains distant from his youngest, Emaan. He carries a silent belief that her birth took away his wife, and that shadow has never left their relationship.
In the same neighborhood lives Humayun, a hardworking tailor and Siraj’s favorite. He quietly loves Narmeen, but keeps his feelings hidden, believing he is not worthy of her.
Like every father, Siraj dreams of seeing his daughters happily married. But before he can fulfill this wish, destiny knocks on his door.
What does fate have in store for Siraj Qasmi? Will Humayun finally confess his love to Narmeen? And will Narmeen ever realize how deeply he loves her?
Geo Entertainment Presentation

programs.title: Sara Aapi
programs.desc:
Sara Aapi is the story of a woman who sacrificed her dreams and the most precious years of her youth to give her three brothers the best upbringing.
After the sudden death of her parents, Sara takes control of both the family and the business. She turns them into success stories, but at the cost of her own personal life. Her world revolves around her brothers, Burhan, Adnan, and Usman.
Over time, Sara becomes strict and commanding. Her decisions become law inside the house. But her strongest test begins when her brothers’ personal desires rise against her authority. Soon, tensions grow and loyalties are tested.
Will Sara choose her authority over her family? Will Sara’s brothers rebel against her decisions? Can Sara keep her family together?
7th Sky Entertainment Presentation

programs.title: Na Maloom Afraad2
programs.desc: Na Maloom Afraad 2 is a 2017 Pakistani action comedy film, co-written and directed by Nabeel Qureshi and produced by Fizza Ali Meerza and Mehdi Ali. A sequel to Na Maloom Afraad. The film stars Fahad Mustafa, Javed Sheikh, Mohsin Abbas Haider and Urwa Hocane reprising their roles from the previous film.  include Marina Khan and Hania Amir are the new edition to the film's cast. While Nayyar Ejaz, Saleem Meraj and Nazr-ul-Hassan played the main antagonists in it.

programs.title: Pyaar Tou Warh Gaya
programs.desc:
Wasay, a vibrant saree shop owner, is content with his life despite being married to his cousin Shazia, a dull and unenthusiastic woman. However, his life takes a dramatic turn when he is swindled by Jamshed, leading to a series of unexpected events.
These events lead to Wasay marrying Manahil, a modern and wealthy woman, in addition to his existing marriage to Shazia. As Wasay navigates his new life, he is blessed with luxurious amenities. However, he struggles to balance his time between his two wives, who are unaware of each other's existence.
Manahil and Shazia, determined to win Wasay's attention, transform themselves, leading to a series of comedic events. In an attempt to manage his dual life, Wasay concocts a plan that backfires, landing him in even deeper trouble.
Will Shazia find out that Wasay has married Manahil? Will Manahil discover that Wasay was already married? Will both of Wasay’s wives confront each other? Can Wasay avoid trouble? Will Wasay end up taking the blame in this situation?
